And so there had never before been such a June, not even in Acadia: such lavish wealth in orchard and garden, such abundant promise of harvest in fields choked with grain. arxiv-2012-15621.title: Open Korean Corpora: A Practical Report
arxiv-2012-15621.creator: Won Ik Cho, Sangwhan Moon, Youngsook Song
arxiv-2012-15621.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Won Ik Cho, Sangwhan Moon, Youngsook Song. Korean is often referred to as a low-resource language in the research community. While this claim is partially true, it is also because the availability of resources is inadequately advertised and curated. This work curates and reviews a list of Korean corpora, first describing institution-level resource development, then further iterate through a list of current open datasets for different types of tasks.

arxiv-2406-09744.description: Abstract We study almost envy-freeness in house allocation, where m m houses are to be allocated among n n agents so that every agent receives exactly one house. arxiv-2601-21026.title: Diffusion-based Annealed Boltzmann Generators : benefits, pitfalls and hopes
arxiv-2601-21026.creator: Louis Grenioux lgrenioux@flatironinstitute.org, Maxence Noble maxence.noble-bourillot@polytechnique.edu
arxiv-2601-21026.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Louis Grenioux lgrenioux@flatironinstitute.org, Maxence Noble maxence.noble-bourillot@polytechnique.edu. Sampling configurations at thermodynamic equilibrium is a central challenge in statistical physics. Boltzmann Generators (BGs) tackle it by combining a generative model with a Monte Carlo (MC) correction step to obtain asymptotically unbiased samples from an unnormalized target. Most current BGs use classic MC mechanisms such as importance sampling, which both require tractable likelihoods from the backbone model and scale poorly in high-dimensional, multi-modal targets.

This retrospective study aimed to determine the characteristics of orofacial amyloidosis to aid dentists in the recognition of this disease.

pmc-12409890.title: Hygrothermal Degradation Behavior and Structural Evolution of Electrospun Poly(ethylene terephthalate) Fiber Mats
pmc-12409890.creator: Keigo Kawahara, Hisao Matsuno, Keiji Tanaka
pmc-12409890.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Growing environmental concerns over plastic waste have recently spurred interest in degradable polymers. Among these, polyesters are considered promising candidates due to the hydrolyzable nature of their ester linkages. While the degradation behavior of aliphatic polyesters, known for their relatively high degradability, has been extensively studied with a focus on aggregation structures, our understanding of aromatic polyesters, which exhibit much lower degradability, remains limited.

pmc-12581318.description: BackgroundProtein disulfide isomerase family A member 4 (PDIA4), a member of the protein disulfide isomerase family, has been associated with the progression of cancer. Nevertheless, its specific function in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is not yet well understood.MethodsTo assess the prognostic significance and functional profile of the PDIA4, survival analysis and GSEA were conducted.

pmc-12595665.title: Rational antibiotic prescribing practices among dentists in Turkey: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12595665.creator: Pelin Ozmen, Alime Okkesim
pmc-12595665.description: Irrational antibiotic use is one of the most important reasons for the rise of antibiotic resistance worldwide. This study questioned how dentists comply with rational antibiotic use (RAU) principles when prescribing antibiotics, their inadequacy, and the need for training. The study included 324 dentists working with patients from public, private, and university settings in Turkey.

pmc-12776211.title: Upregulation of spondin-2 indicates poorer clinical outcomes and induces radioresistance in gastric cancer
pmc-12776211.creator: Yongqin Zhang, Yun Zuo, Dong Hua
pmc-12776211.description: BackgroundSpondin-2 (SPON2) has been reported to be upregulated in various carcinomas, contributing to cancer progression and metastasis. However, its underlying mechanism in gastric cancer (GC) remains poorly understood. This study aimed to explore the relationship between SPON2 expression, prognostic outcomes, and radiotherapy sensitivity in GC.

pmc-13018725.creator: Ashley N. Linden‐Carmichael, Jacqueline Mogle, Sara E. Miller, Jennifer L. Shipley, Stephen J. Wilson
pmc-13018725.description: BackgroundYoung adults (ages ~ 18–25) are at highest risk of heavy alcohol use relative to other age groups. Scant research has focused on identifying whether young adults experience functional cognitive consequences after drinking and alcohol‐induced memory loss (“blackout drinking”) events.
